# iflow Psychology

> > Evidence-based psychology and counselling services in Gladesville, Sydney, offering assessments, therapy, and Medicare-funded care with culturally inclusive, trauma-informed practice.

iflow Psychology is an AHPRA-registered psychology clinic in Gladesville, Sydney, providing comprehensive mental health services including counselling, psychological assessments, couples/family support, workplace psychology, and NDIS-funded services. The practice emphasizes evidence-based, trauma-informed, and culturally sensitive care across multiple Sydney locations.

## Key Topics

- Psychology Services

## Core Services

- [Psychology & Counselling Services](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/services): iflow Psychology services overview: counselling, assessments, couples, families, workplace.
- [Counselling & Therapy in Gladesville](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/gladesville/counselling-and-therapy): Evidence-based counselling for anxiety, depression, trauma, relationships, life transitions.
- [Psychological Assessments](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/gladesville/assessments): Psychological assessments: ADHD, autism, cognitive, educational, neurodevelopmental testing.
- [Couples & Family Counselling](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/gladesville/couples-and-family-support): Couples and family counselling for relationships, communication, parenting, separation.
- [Workplace & EAP Psychology](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/gladesville/workplace-psychology): Workplace psychology and EAP: stress management, return-to-work, rehabilitation support.
- [NDIS Psychology Services](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/gladesville/ndis-psychology): NDIS-funded psychology: mental health support, assessments, capacity building.
- [Psychologists (Directory)](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/psychologists): Directory of psychologists at iflow Psychology with specialties and qualifications.
- [Who We Support Across Sydney](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/services/who-we-see): iflow Psychology services for children, teens, adults, couples, and families.

## About & Approach

- [About iflow Psychology](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/about): About iflow Psychology: AHPRA-registered team providing evidence-based counselling since 2015.
- [Our Approach to Care](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/about/our-approach): iflow Psychology's evidence-based, trauma-informed, culturally inclusive therapy approach.
- [Mission & Values](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/about/mission-and-values): iflow Psychology's LIFE values: Leadership, Integrity, Flow, Excellence guiding client care.
- [Inclusive Care for LGBTQIA+, CALD & Disability Communities](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/about/inclusive-care): iflow Psychology's commitment to LGBTQIA+, CALD, and disability-inclusive mental health care.
- [Culturally Sensitive Psychological Services](https://www.iflowpsychology.com.au/services/culturally-sensitive-psychological-services-gladesville-sydney): Culturally sensitive therapy for CALD clients with multilingual support and migration assistance.
